import scipy
import scipy.linalg

from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, abc, ab, bc, d):
        assert np.ndim(abc) == 0
        assert np.ndim(ab) == 0
        assert np.ndim(bc) == 0
        assert np.ndim(d) == 0
        # f = abcabbcd
        self.f = abc * ab * bc * d
